lines.text: As a teacher, it's important to understand your students.
Did you have a question, Commander?

Once I'm finished grading these tests, I have to prepare for the communal assessments and arrange one-to-one interviews with the students... 
And then there's a demonstration class for a new subject.
If you're going to school today, would you want to go together?

Cat-shaped cherry cakes are all the rage right now. 
I'll have to try some so that I can keep up with the newest trends among my students.

Lovely Sweets Magazines...
Ah, I'm buying these just so I can better connect with my students.
I'll be marking the students' tests.
... Commander, are you still busy?

As a teacher, I always welcome questions. 
If there is anything you're curious about, please ask.

Commander?
I'm on my way to the library to gather some materials.
Whenever I take a stroll here, it puts my mind at ease.

I'm Marciana, and I teach at the M. M. R. vocational school.
I always do my best to provide the best learning experience for my students.
I should be able to provide the students with better instruction.
This is sure to cut down on the prep time necessary for class.
I'll go prepare a new lesson plan.
Thank you, Commander.
I always feel that this is improving the teaching experience I provide my students.
Is this for me? Thank you, Commander.
I'm so thankful for everything you've done.
Thanks to you, I feel like my knowledge is expanding.
Are you... planning on sticking around in the future?
Are you planning on attending class, Commander?
I'm ready.
On my way.
Should I begin?
It's time I bring this class to a close.
This is an educational experience as well.
It's time I teach all of you a lesson.
Reloading.
I have to do some quick maintenance.
Give me just a second.
We're ready for class.
Time for class to begin.
Pay attention in class!
I've handled it.
Well done.
Class is over.
Ugh...
I'm okay.
Hnrgh!
I'm sorry... I'll have to leave the rest to you.
I should start preparing for the next class.

All right, let's start the cla...
Oh, wait. I'm a student now.

Comma... No, Teacher.
It's still a bit awkward calling you that...
What lesson will you start with today?

This school uniform is more uncomfortable than I expected.
It feels much too tight.

Teacher, I'm not sure about this part.
Could you help me?
A one-on-one lesson? I'm a little nervous.
Please go ahead. I'll stay here and study.

Teacher, are you busy?
I feel a bit... self-conscious standing here alone in this outfit.
I hope I won't bump into any students...
I'll follow your lead, Comma... I mean, Teacher.
I didn't realize walking around in sneakers would be so comfortable.

Even though it's just for a day,
there's still a lot I want to learn from you, Teacher.
My knowledge has increased.
A most impressive methodology.

Thank you, Comma... Teacher.
Your instruction is second to none.
Is it okay to give me something this nice?
You're so kind, Teacher.
I'm so happy, Comma... Teacher.
I've always respected you.
Would it be okay if I let you take the reins a bit more, Teacher?

Thanks to you, I feel like I can empathize more with the students.
... I'm feeling strangely nervous.
I'll stick closer to you, Comma... I mean, Teacher.
Yes? Did you call?
I'll follow along.
I am fully prepared.
A-are we going out like this?
I will be... a diligent student.
Awaiting instruction.
Reloading.
Like... this?
This skirt is such a pain.
I'm ready, Teacher.
What's today's lesson, Teacher?
Let's finish this!
Whew.
It's all taken care of.
It's finished.
Ow!
*Cough*
No way...!
I'm sorry that I failed you...
Let's go back to the classroom now, Teacher.
